# Puppertino (selected modules)

CSS modules from [codedgar/Puppertino](https://github.com/codedgar/Puppertino), commit `30a21ae7052b460097d153d488a0023059236a6a` (MIT, copyright Edgar Pérez). Only trailing whitespace is normalized; CSS behavior is unchanged.

Only buttons, forms, segmented controls, and dark-mode variables are included. They are bundled locally, with no CDN requests or JavaScript runtime. Translect's popup.css supplies the compact macOS layout, system color adaptation, and keyboard/reduced-motion accessibility corrections (the upstream switch hides its input with display:none).

This is an Apple-inspired third-party CSS framework, not Apple's native Liquid Glass implementation. See LICENSE for redistribution terms.
